skills.name: local-designer
skills.description: Local image design for agents: agent-aikido-art-director agent and agent-aikido-image-analyst agent (images are read silently: the project's optional local vision-language model, otherwise the current model), structured client brief and mood board (directions shown in several scenes, palette with roles, typography, textures, what each direction rules out, page preview) with a validation lock before generation, a per-project design target (charter, styles, mood boards and UI kit in one versioned folder, /aikido-init-design) with palette audit, a UI kit generated from the brand colours (five personalities to choose from, light and dark tokens checked for contrast, components, icons, WebP button skins and zone backgrounds, /aikido-design-uikit), 29 illustrated render styles, style recommendation from a brief, an image or a project, sweeps kept outside git, parameter knowledge base. Generation through a connector: Draw Things over HTTP or gRPC (server's real model list, TLS with fingerprint, local or remote server), ComfyUI planned.
